project_type: React SPA with Vite + FastAPI BFF backend (manga translation app)
build_system: Vite for frontend, pip for backend. Scripts in package.json.
test_framework: No frontend tests (user explicitly said not to add). Backend uses pytest.
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build
test_command: npm run typecheck && npm run build
verification_instructions: Run `npm run typecheck && npm run build` in the project root to verify no TS errors and vite builds successfully.
setup_instructions: npm install in project root. Backend: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
environment_constraints: No tests to add per user request. Must keep typecheck+build passing. Branch from current HEAD (phase-4a-feature-extraction).
contribution_requirements: Do NOT add tests. Keep typecheck + build passing. Create branch phase-3-5-remaining from current HEAD.
key_patterns: Zustand stores with persist middleware in store/. Feature hooks in features/translator/. Pipeline API in services/api/pipelineApi.ts. Types in types.ts (flat file). IndexedDB pattern in services/imageStorage.ts (same DB, versioned upgrades). BubbleOverlay.tsx handles rendering. MangaViewer.tsx has handleDownload for canvas export.
directory_structure: Root: App.tsx, types.ts, index.tsx. store/ has zustand stores. features/ has settings modals and translator hooks. services/ has API client and IndexedDB. components/ has MangaViewer and BubbleOverlay. backend/ is FastAPI.
